summary: Write and, on approval, run qpu:ascella jobs that serve theta2-x-arm0 at fresh QRNG compilation seeds, and score on those unseen meshes the heater and coupler offsets frozen from jobs 00, 02 and 03.

reconciliation.note: Plan ascella-fixed-mesh-confirmation read the heater and coupler offsets on the 28 held-out meshes at r 0.318 (one-sided p 0.050), not carried at alpha 0.01, with a 99 % Fisher-z upper bound of r 0.661, and spent the held-out half. Job-03 (claim ascella-signed-coherence-seed-repeat) showed each served mesh's X statistic fixed across a calibration with steady anchors, so meshes served by later jobs join one test set. The offsets below are frozen from retained data before any new seed is drawn; the served meshes are known only from the returned computed_circuit, so the plan freezes parameters, and a prediction is a deterministic function of the returned phases and couplers.

scope: Jobs job-04 and job-05 each submit theta2-x-arm0 (configuration 13 of job-00) 64 times at 16,384 samples per iteration: seed-0 anchors at every eighth position and 56 positions at new compilation seeds, the nonzero values of one ANU QRNG draw taken in index order with repeats and job-02's 56 seeds skipped, job-04 the first 56 and job-05 the next 56. The owner may approve job-04 alone, both, or both plus a third job job-06 on the following 56 values; the readings take the meshes of every job run. Predictors, frozen in docs/evidence/ascella-order-coefficients/new-mesh-offsets.json, family heater_0.3_coupler_0.1_offsets: P-A, the offsets fitted on job-00 plus the 28 exploration meshes of mesh-split.json (the fit plan ascella-fixed-mesh-confirmation scored); P-B, the offsets fitted on job-00 plus all 56 perturbed meshes of jobs 02 and 03 pooled by setting name. A prediction is static_light of the returned mesh under the frozen offsets. Readings: M, mesh identity, the count of distinct new served meshes and of any equal to a mesh of jobs 00 to 03; P-A and P-B read only the new distinct meshes, n. A, anchor control, each job's anchor mean X against job-03's 0.8858 in counting standard errors, descriptive. Primary, for each predictor: the Pearson correlation of predicted with observed block-conditioned X after centering both within each job, one-sided against r <= 0 by the t distribution on n - 1 - jobs degrees of freedom at alpha 0.005 each (Bonferroni 0.01 over the two predictors); p below 0.005 reads carried. At 112 meshes the critical r is 0.244 and power is 0.79 at the held-out 0.318 and 0.99 at 0.437, attenuation ceiling 0.967 at 16,384 samples. Secondary, descriptive: r^2 against the squared ceiling as a point estimate and at the one-sided 99.5 % Fisher-z bounds, the Spearman correlation, the affine slope, and job-02's R1 dispersion ratio on the new meshes. Exploratory and outside the decision: the same correlation pooled with the 28 held-out meshes of plan ascella-fixed-mesh-confirmation. A carried P-A refutes the design statement that the returned circuit with element offsets does not carry the fixed per-mesh error, for the share r^2 states; a not-carried P-A and P-B with upper bounds below the held-out point estimate close the static element offsets as a carrier. The readings spend every new mesh: a family proposed after scoring needs further seeds or the applied voltages of Perceval#799.
next_action: The owner approves, resizes or declines the written case in the design document's section 'New-seed meshes case (job-04 and job-05)'.

steps.action: Fit P-A and P-B on retained data and write their offsets, free masks and covariance digests before any new seed is drawn.
steps.acceptance: new-mesh-offsets.json exists and replays under --check; P-A's offsets reproduce fixed-mesh-frozen-predictions.json.

receipts.result: new-mesh-offsets.json freezes P-A (58 training meshes) and P-B (86) at 258 free offsets each, committed and pushed in 9e92be5 before any new seed was drawn; P-A reproduces fixed-mesh-frozen-predictions.json to 9e-15.

steps.action: Draw the seeds from the ANU QRNG and register jobs 04 to 06 in ascella_coherence_request.py with the anchors at stride 8, the frozen bodies and a preflight that sends nothing.
steps.acceptance: --check reproduces the frozen bytes of jobs 00 to 03 and validates the new jobs; no new seed equals a seed of job-02 or zero.

receipts.result: ascella_coherence_request.py registers jobs 04 to 06, each 56 new seeds from draw-2026-10-26T174307Z indices 0 to 167 with job-02's seeds skipped plus 8 seed-0 anchors; --check rebuilds jobs 00 to 03 to their retained bytes and validates the three new frozen bodies, none sent; the 224 seeds of jobs 02 and 04 to 06 are distinct and nonzero.

steps.action: Write the case in the design document: what it measures, why simulation cannot answer it, backend, sizing options, seconds and credits.
steps.acceptance: The owner approves the case at a size, or declines it.

steps.action: Submit the approved jobs, collect and retain them, and apply M, A and the two primary readings as fixed here, with the secondary and exploratory readings labeled.
steps.acceptance: Retained runs and a reading record with every fixed reading, replayed by a gate.
